verdict.rationale: Figma markets an in-product AI agent that generates design directions, diagrams, edits images, and searches files from your data (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-docs-51, figma-docs-43), which matches the story of AI-generated insights/suggestions from data. However, hands-on community feedback directly contradicts this for at least part of the surface: 'the AI tools in FigJam are really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), while another user reports positive use of AI summarization (figma-comm-9), creating a real dispute rather than mere skepticism. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of the core Figma (not just FigJam) AI agent's accuracy/reliability, and clearer evidence the insight-generation quality matches vendor claims broadly.
